verdicts.reason: A is broken. The headline's second line, 'week', runs into the subtitle. The '48' and the cream 'per year' text spill out of the dark card onto the light background, where they become unreadable. The 'per month' and 'up to 5 people' lines also sit outside their cards, and the legal text is jammed under the subtitle. B has a clear, dominant headline and CTA, but the three plan cards are shrunk to thumbnails with illegible labels and they are out of order (6, 80, 48). The subtitle and legal copy are crammed into a tiny block at the right edge, and the logo is undersized. B is flawed but much less broken than A.
